reason: The read-only operations implementation is fail-closed, but Production has no Supabase Auth URL or public key and no verified operations_admin actor. An operator cannot access the private dashboard without a separately authorized auth setup.

productionReadOnlySample.deploymentShaLimitation: CLI inspect did not expose the Git SHA; the dashboard uses VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA when available and otherwise displays unknown.

KAKAO_MAPS.reason: This read-only sample did not render the SDK in a browser.

MAPLIBRE_BASE_MAP.reason: Navigation HTTP 200 does not prove canvas rendering.

productionReadOnlySample.sampleMeaning: Six public page requests were 200. Disabled source 503 responses are expected and excluded from service 5xx health. No historical error rate or SLA was measured.

implementation.auth: Supabase auth.getUser plus app_metadata.operations_role=operations_admin; no user_metadata trust; no public fallback
implementation.pathBoundary: Exact operations path middleware returns HTTP 404 with noindex/nofollow before page streaming when auth is unavailable or unauthorized.

limitations: Private dashboard cannot be viewed in current Production or Preview because Supabase Auth variables and an operations_admin actor are absent.
Kakao SDK availability and MapLibre canvas rendering require an authenticated browser; HTTP route checks do not prove them.
RISA source timestamp timezone and provider quota are undocumented.
FEMO remains disabled and historical; salinity unit is undocumented, DO unit is documented.
KMA Production sources and KHOA tide/navigation warning remain disabled or without keys.
The dashboard has no long-term 5xx/latency history, cross-instance cache, automatic alert, recovery, or rollback.
